stories.headline: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
stories.dek: Micron's quarterly report drew attention to earnings, guidance and rapid data-center revenue growth.
tldr: CNBC reported that Micron beat earnings expectations and issued strong guidance.
CNBC said data-center revenue increased 11-fold; Seeking Alpha's market briefing also listed Micron among companies beating estimates.
The reports describe company results and guidance, without implying a future share-price outcome.

body.text: CNBC reported that Micron beat earnings expectations and issued strong guidance, with data-center revenue up 11-fold. Seeking Alpha's morning market briefing separately included Micron among companies beating estimates.
The reports place data-center demand among the context for Micron's results. They do not establish how durable that growth will be or how markets will price the outlook.

stories.whyItMatters: Micron's results connect semiconductor demand with data-center investment, a major source of current industry growth. The reported jump is backward-looking and does not by itself resolve whether demand or margins will persist.
stories.editorNote: Two independent outlets reported the earnings beat; the 11-fold figure is attributed specifically to CNBC. YMYL review: no investment advice or price signal.

stories.headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2002 as global bond rout gathers pace
stories.dek: CNBC and Asia Business Daily report a long-dated U.S. yield reaching a level last seen more than two decades ago.
tldr: CNBC reported that the 10-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since 2002 as a global bond selloff gathered pace.
Asia Business Daily also reported that the 10-year yield reached a level not seen since 2002, alongside mixed U.S. equity-index closes.
The reports describe market conditions, not a forecast or a trading signal.

body.text: CNBC reported that the 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2002 amid a broader bond selloff. Asia Business Daily independently reported a 10-year yield high not seen since 2002 and said U.S. stock indexes finished mixed.

Long-dated government yields are a reference point for borrowing costs across markets. The reports establish the move and its timing, but do not identify one confirmed cause or indicate how long elevated yields will persist.

stories.whyItMatters: A sharp rise in long-dated government borrowing costs can feed into financing conditions across credit and housing. The coverage describes a market move; it does not establish a durable shift in rates or prescribe a portfolio response.
stories.editorNote: Two independent outlets report the level and historical comparison. YMYL review: neutral market reporting; no advice or rate prediction.
